subject: Observe events related to programmatically generated inputs with variable names

messages.author: 168108786ace8174
messages.subject: Observe events related to programmatically generated inputs with variable names
parts:
Hi all!
I want to describe my issue and ask for help of the community.

I am trying to create an example of a ShinyApp that allows to automatically generate UI inputs for some scalars provided in a named list. For example, I feed my App with this list:

method <- list('Method name' = "My Great Method", 
                      'Post process' = TRUE,
                      'Iterations' = 20).

The App should scan this list and create an input for each element of the list. Ids of the inputs should be set to be equal to the tranformed names of the elements in the list (e.g. lowercase and without whitespace). This part is solved programmatically by me. But how to react on changes in these inputs? I do not know, in general, names of these inputs and therefore can't use them in an observe() to implement reactive behaviour...


I hope I described everything clearly and recieve an answer soon. Thank you in advance!
